---
title: "About me"
subtitle: "Plant scientist moving into bioinformatics"
toc: true

I grew up in Sri Lanka and started in the lab: extracting DNA, running PCRs and growing
vegetables hydroponically. Along the way I noticed that the most interesting questions were in the
data, so I moved into bioinformatics. I hold a First Class BSc (Hons) in Biotechnology and am
completing an MSc in Bioinformatics at the University of Birmingham Dubai.

I like questions where plant biology meets data: crop stress, disease and the genetics behind them.
And I care about doing the analysis properly, because a model that scores well on a lucky split
helps nobody.
